targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    CAST(avg(c.latitude) AS DOUBLE) AS lat,
    CAST(avg(c.longitude) AS DOUBLE) AS lon,
    c.city,
    c.country_name,
    d.server_site,
    count() AS total_testes
FROM download d
JOIN client c ON d.client_ip = c.client_ip
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.test_time)
    AND $__conditionalAll(d.server_site IN ($server), $server)
    AND c.country_code = 'BR'
    AND c.latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND c.longitude IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.city, c.country_name, d.server_site
LIMIT 500

SELECT
    CAST(s.latitude AS DOUBLE) AS lat,
    CAST(s.longitude AS DOUBLE) AS lon,
    s.server_ip,
    d.server_site,
    s.city,
    s.country_name,
    count() AS total_testes,
    count(DISTINCT d.client_ip) AS clientes_unicos
FROM download d
JOIN server s ON d.server_ip = s.server_ip
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.test_time)
    AND $__conditionalAll(d.server_site IN ($server), $server)
    AND s.latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND s.longitude IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.latitude, s.longitude, s.server_ip, d.server_site, s.city, s.country_name
